# Load packages and read the data

```{r}
# Load required packages.
# Install packages once if needed; library() loads them for each session.

# install.packages("ggplot2")
# install.packages("dplyr")
# install.packages("tidyr")
# install.packages("ggforce")
# install.packages("openxlsx")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggforce)
library(openxlsx)

# Read the prepared exacerbation dataset.
# The dataset is not included in this public repository.
# Place an authorised local copy in data/processed/ before running this script.

data_EXAC <- read.xlsx(
  "data/processed/data_EXAC.xlsx",
  sheet = 1
)
```


# Check missing weekly follow-up data

```{r}
# Create one row for every participant and each of the 48 planned
# follow-up weeks, including weeks without a questionnaire record.
all_weeks <- expand.grid(
  patid = unique(data_EXAC$patid),
  fu_week = 1:48
)

# Mark observed questionnaire records, then merge them with the complete
# participant-week grid. Weeks without a matching record are marked 0;
# weeks with a record are marked 1.
plot_data <- all_weeks %>%
  mutate(has_data = 0) %>%
  left_join(
    data_EXAC %>% mutate(has_data = 1),
    by = c("patid", "fu_week"),
    suffix = c("", ".y")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    has_data = ifelse(is.na(has_data.y), has_data, has_data.y)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(patid, fu_week, has_data)

# Keep one row per participant and follow-up week.
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  distinct(patid, fu_week, .keep_all = TRUE)
```


# Plot questionnaire completeness by participant

```{r}
# Define participant IDs
ltfu_patids <- # add IDs here
late_start_patids <- # add IDs here

# Create annotation data for participants with incomplete follow-up.
annot_df <- data.frame(
  patid = ltfu_patids,
  x = rep(40, length(ltfu_patids)),
  y = rep(0.5, length(ltfu_patids)),
  label = rep("LTFU", length(ltfu_patids))
)

# Create annotation data for participants who started follow-up late.
late_start_df <- data.frame(
  patid = late_start_patids,
  x = rep(5, length(late_start_patids)),
  y = rep(0.5, length(late_start_patids)),
  label = rep("Late start", length(late_start_patids))
)

# Combine the annotation data.
annotations <- rbind(annot_df, late_start_df)

# Assign colours according to treatment group.
# CTgroup and IVgroup must be defined in the local analysis environment.
plot_data$group_color <- ifelse(
  plot_data$patid %in% CTgroup, "CTgroup",
  ifelse(plot_data$patid %in% IVgroup, "IVgroup", "Other")
)

# Set up the number of participant panels per page.
ncol <- 3
nrow <- 4
n_per_page <- ncol * nrow

# Count the unique participants and calculate the number of pages needed.
n_panels <- length(unique(plot_data$patid))
n_pages <- ceiling(n_panels / n_per_page)

# Create the output directory if it does not already exist.
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Save the plots as a multi-page PDF.
pdf(
  "figures/missing_EXAC_questionnaires.pdf",
  width = 14,
  height = 16
)

for (i in 1:n_pages) {

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = fu_week, y = has_data, fill = group_color)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "CTgroup" = "orange",
      "IVgroup" = "steelblue",
      "Other" = "grey"
    )) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 48, by = 2),
      limits = c(0, 48)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 1),
      limits = c(0, 1.1)
    ) +
    ggforce::facet_wrap_paginate(
      ~patid,
      ncol = ncol,
      nrow = nrow,
      page = i,
      scales = "free_x"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = annotations,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "purple3",
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Follow-up week",
      y = "Weekly EXAC questionnaire present (1 = yes)",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  print(p)
}

dev.off()
```



# Add exacerbation, hospital visit and antibiotic indicators

```{r}
# Identify weeks with a recorded hospital visit or a hospital-related
# medication-change indicator.
data_EXAC <- data_EXAC %>%
  mutate(
    all_zkh_fu_week = case_when(
      EXAmed_change_weekly == 4 ~ fu_week,
      EXAhospital_visit == 1 ~ fu_week
    )
  )

# Identify weeks with a recorded antibiotic course or an antibiotic-related
# medication-change indicator.
data_EXAC <- data_EXAC %>%
  mutate(
    all_ab_fu_week = case_when(
      EXAmed_change_weekly == 3 ~ fu_week,
      EXAantibiotics == 1 ~ fu_week
    )
  )

# Extract the participant-week combinations corresponding to recorded
# exacerbations. Exclude missing event weeks.
exa_points <- data_EXAC %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(all_exa_fu_week),
    all_exa_fu_week == fu_week
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(patid, fu_week)

# Extract participant-week combinations corresponding to hospital visits.
zkh_points <- data_EXAC %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(all_zkh_fu_week),
    all_zkh_fu_week == fu_week
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(patid, fu_week)

# Extract participant-week combinations corresponding to antibiotic use.
ab_points <- data_EXAC %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(all_ab_fu_week),
    all_ab_fu_week == fu_week
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(patid, fu_week)

# Save the plots with event indicators as a multi-page PDF.
pdf(
  "figures/missing_EXAC_questionnaires_with_events.pdf",
  width = 14,
  height = 16
)

for (i in 1:n_pages) {

  p_exa_hospi_ab <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = fu_week, y = has_data, fill = group_color)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "CTgroup" = "orange",
      "IVgroup" = "steelblue",
      "Other" = "grey"
    )) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 48, by = 2),
      limits = c(0, 48)
    ) +
    # Extend the y-axis to make space for the event markers.
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 1),
      limits = c(0, 1.2)
    ) +
    ggforce::facet_wrap_paginate(
      ~patid,
      ncol = ncol,
      nrow = nrow,
      page = i,
      scales = "free_x"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = annotations,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "purple3",
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    # Black dots indicate weeks with a recorded exacerbation.
    geom_point(
      data = exa_points,
      aes(x = fu_week, y = 1.05),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      size = 3
    ) +
    # White-filled circles with black outlines indicate hospital visits.
    geom_point(
      data = zkh_points,
      aes(x = fu_week, y = 1.10),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      fill = "white",
      shape = 21,
      size = 3
    ) +
    # Grey dots indicate weeks with recorded antibiotic use.
    geom_point(
      data = ab_points,
      aes(x = fu_week, y = 1.15),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "grey",
      size = 3
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Follow-up week",
      y = "Weekly EXAC questionnaire present (1 = yes)",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  print(p_exa_hospi_ab)
}

dev.off()
```



# Display participants grouped by treatment arm

```{r}
# Order participants by treatment group, followed by any participants
# not included in either treatment-group vector.
ordered_patids <- c(
  IVgroup,
  CTgroup,
  setdiff(unique(plot_data$patid), c(IVgroup, CTgroup))
)

# Apply the same participant order to the plot data and annotations.
plot_data$patid <- factor(
  plot_data$patid,
  levels = ordered_patids
)

annotations$patid <- factor(
  annotations$patid,
  levels = ordered_patids
)

exa_points$patid <- factor(
  exa_points$patid,
  levels = ordered_patids
)

zkh_points$patid <- factor(
  zkh_points$patid,
  levels = ordered_patids
)

ab_points$patid <- factor(
  ab_points$patid,
  levels = ordered_patids
)

# Save the treatment-group-ordered plots.
pdf(
  "figures/missing_EXAC_questionnaires_with_events_by_group.pdf",
  width = 14,
  height = 16
)

for (i in 1:n_pages) {

  p_exa_hospi_ab <- ggplot(
    plot_data,
    aes(x = fu_week, y = has_data, fill = group_color)
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
      "CTgroup" = "orange",
      "IVgroup" = "steelblue",
      "Other" = "grey"
    )) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = seq(0, 48, by = 2),
      limits = c(0, 48)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(0, 1),
      limits = c(0, 1.2)
    ) +
    ggforce::facet_wrap_paginate(
      ~patid,
      ncol = ncol,
      nrow = nrow,
      page = i,
      scales = "free_x"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = annotations,
      aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "purple3",
      size = 5,
      fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = exa_points,
      aes(x = fu_week, y = 1.05),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      size = 3
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = zkh_points,
      aes(x = fu_week, y = 1.10),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "black",
      fill = "white",
      shape = 21,
      size = 3
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = ab_points,
      aes(x = fu_week, y = 1.15),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = "grey",
      size = 3
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Follow-up week",
      y = "Weekly EXAC questionnaire present (1 = yes)",
      fill = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(),
      legend.position = "none"
    )

  print(p_exa_hospi_ab)
}

dev.off()
```
